traits.value: Elevation and vertical accuracy · Canopy and vegetation height · Fog/cloud presence · Air temperature · Humidity · Slope and aspect
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Submontane, montane and mossy forest should not be separated by arbitrary universal altitude limits.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record moss and bryophyte cover on branches and stems, stature of the canopy, epiphyte abundance and exposure. Avoid labeling every high-elevation grassland as mossy forest.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Document mist frequency, ridgeline position, organic-rich litter, saturated substrates and water movement when actually observed.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Often supports specialized upland flora and fauna. The profile describes habitat structure, not automatic endemic-species presence.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Percent epiphyte cover · Canopy height · Litter depth · Temperature/humidity · GPS altitude and datum · Cloud exposure
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Disturbance and local climate alter structure. Confirm mossy features on the ground.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Document exposed limestone, sinkholes, crevices, thin soils, abrupt microtopography and cliff habitat. Note forest cover separately.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Record surface runoff paths, cave moisture and dry rock crevices without entering unsafe voids. Substrate-specific microhabitats matter.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Karst flora may show substrate specialization. Cave and cliff observations require separate search effort and disturbance notes.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Limestone cover estimate · Rock and soil depth class · Canopy openness · Cliff/cave proximity · Microhabitat search time
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: A species occurring in karst forest is not necessarily a limestone specialist. Confirm rock type rather than assuming it from vegetation.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Describe substrate exposure, vegetation stature, leaf characteristics, patchiness and transitions into other soil types.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Record drainage, bare-rock patches and soil color. Chemical soil identity requires an actual geologic or laboratory source.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Possible local plant community specialization. Wildlife use must be documented directly, not inferred from underlying rock.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Geological/soil identification source · Canopy height · Vegetation cover · Rock exposure · Disturbance evidence
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Do not assign ultramafic habitat from small-tree stature alone. Separate field impression from verified geology.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Look for tidal influence, prop roots or pneumatophores, salt-tolerant woody vegetation, muddy or sandy intertidal zones. Record the precise microzone.
traits.source: Philippine Statistics Authority · Mangrove ecosystem definition

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Note inundation state, approximate tidal position, salinity reading if measured, standing water and sediment type.
traits.source: Philippine Statistics Authority · Mangrove ecosystem definition

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Common mangrove genera include Rhizophora, Avicennia and Bruguiera. Root networks support many invertebrates, fish and coastal birds.
traits.source: Philippine Statistics Authority · Mangrove ecosystem definition

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Tidal stage and time · Salinity with instrument/method · Porewater/surface water status · Substrate type · Canopy cover · Disturbance/replanting status
traits.source: Philippine Statistics Authority · Mangrove ecosystem definition

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Planted stands and natural forest differ. One photograph does not confirm exact salinity or plant identity.
traits.source: Philippine Statistics Authority · Mangrove ecosystem definition

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record the dominant growth form, permanent or seasonal flooding, open-water patches and water-edge transitions.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Measure water depth and field conductivity or salinity when feasible. Document water clarity, flow, mud or organic substrate and seasonality.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Anuran calls, waterbirds and aquatic species should be associated with actual observation records and sampling effort.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Standing water depth · Conductivity/salinity if measured · Flow and turbidity · Vegetation cover · Survey date and wet/dry phase
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: A one-day observation cannot determine permanent hydroperiod. Do not equate absence of water with habitat absence.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Identify channel, banks, riparian canopy, flood marks, erosion and vegetation transition. Record whether the survey is in-channel, bank-edge or adjacent forest.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Measure stream width, wetted width, water depth, flow class, channel substrate and sampling-bank distance.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Stream-associated amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals may use different microhabitats. Record detections by observed substrate.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Channel width · Depth and flow state · Stream bed material · Bank canopy · Water temperature · GPS accuracy
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Riparian is a landscape position and can coexist with another forest category. No assumed water chemistry.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record canopy regeneration, planted versus native vegetation, stumps, trail/road edges, gaps, invasive plants and nearby land use.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Document drainage modifications, exposed soil, erosion, water channels and fire evidence.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Mixed natural regeneration and planted trees can coexist. Describe actual vegetation rather than an unverified 'pristine' status.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Time or evidence of disturbance · Canopy cover · Regeneration density · Dominant land use · Edge distance · Human activity
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Forest cover alone does not quantify ecological integrity. Classify disturbance and forest structure independently.
traits.source: Field Museum / Philippine Mammals project · Habitats in the Philippines

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record canopy stature, exposure, woody plant forms, patches of shrub and canopy, observed mist, and local habitat transitions. Do not infer a subalpine forest solely from a high GPS elevation.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Measure rock exposure, drainage, organic horizon, wind exposure and slope position where safe and feasible.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Record actual plant taxa and structure, not a predicted set of associated vertebrates. The existence of this forest formation does not imply local presence of a particular mammal or bird.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: GPS height and vertical uncertainty · Vegetation height and canopy closure · Actual dominant plants · Slope and exposure · Soil and organic surface horizon · Temperature and humidity if measured
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Elevation bands differ across mountains and islands. Require field vegetation evidence and cite the source classification, not an assumed national elevation threshold.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Look for woody beach or backshore vegetation on sand or coastal shingle landward of the active swash. Document erosion, tourism, plantation history and natural regeneration.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Record sand, shell or shingle substrate and salt-spray exposure. Do not mark tide-washed intertidal mangrove mud as beach forest.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Record coastal trees only after identification. Beach plant lists depend on local island, exposure and human modification.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Shoreline position and substrate · Evidence of salt spray and tide reach · Canopy cover and tree heights · Coastal disturbance · Plant composition · Photographic transect
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Beach forest and planted coconut belts are not equivalent. Verify natural woody assemblages and site history.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record woody canopy, standing freshwater or saturating soils, water-level marks, and roots exposed to periodic inundation.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Check freshwater source, seasonality, organic or mineral substrate, and presence of drains, tidal mixing or upstream floodwater.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Document actual woody plants and epiphytes, plus wildlife observations independently. A wetland label does not establish wildlife occupancy.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Water depth and recent flood level · Canopy cover · Surface-water salinity or conductivity · Soil condition · Flood-season evidence · Dominant woody plants
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: A flooded plantation, saltwater mangrove or open marsh is not automatically freshwater swamp forest. Seasonal field conditions must be documented.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Look for forested waterlogged soils and substantial organic soil layers. Do not label a black-colored wetland peat without appropriate soil evidence.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Record peat depth where sampling is authorized, water table, drainage, organic substrate, and any evidence of burning or drying.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Record actual forest vegetation and any special substrate-associated plants. Habitat photographs alone cannot confirm a deep peat profile.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Peat thickness if assessed · Water-table observations · Soil organic matter evidence · Vegetation structure · Drainage channels · Disturbance or fire evidence
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Peat requires substrate evidence, not appearance alone. Distinguish shallow organic topsoil on mineral deposits from peat.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Record actual canopy phenology, evergreen and seasonal leaf-shedding tree components, tree layering, and the time of year sampled.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Document local seasonality, drainage and soil type rather than assigning rainfall and drought values without measurements.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Record canopy leaf condition and identified tree taxa across seasons. A dry-looking canopy in one visit is not sufficient for classification.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Season and date · Canopy foliage phenology · Tree-species composition · Canopy cover · Soil moisture if measured · Land-use history
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: Leaf loss may reflect disturbance, pests or short droughts. Repeat or historical vegetation evidence is needed to separate formation from adjacent types.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Habitat recognition
traits.value: Document seasonal leaf shedding in naturally established forest and mature tree structure, distinguishing it from recently cleared or damaged evergreen forests.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Water, geology and substrate
traits.value: Record soil, drainage, landform and seasonal moisture conditions. Do not infer climate from a single dry field visit.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Vegetation and wildlife context
traits.value: Note confirmed deciduous and evergreen components, stand history and wildlife detections separately.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Recommended field measurements
traits.value: Leaf phenology and season · Tree community · Canopy and understory structure · Soil and drainage · Disturbance history · Repeat seasonal observations
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations

traits.label: Identification limits
traits.value: A defoliated secondary stand is not automatically a natural deciduous forest. Published formation criteria and seasonal records should guide classification.
traits.source: DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau · Philippine Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan 2024–2040, DAO 2025-23: Philippine forest formations
